neighbours.label: The surround word family as a token (' surrounded', ' surrounding', ' surround', Chinese 圍/围), not synonyms such as encircled, ringed or among.
fire: The castle is surrounded by a deep moat filled with green water.
As a child she was surrounded by books and music.
The farmhouse was surrounded on three sides by orchards.
Police surrounded the building shortly after midnight.
The surrounding villages were evacuated before the storm.
Thick fog surrounded the ship as it entered the harbour.
He felt calm, surrounded by friends on his last evening in town.
quiet: The castle is protected by a deep moat filled with green water.
As a child she grew up with books and music everywhere.
The farmhouse was enclosed on three sides by orchards.
Police entered the building shortly after midnight.
The nearby villages were evacuated before the storm.
Thick fog covered the ship as it entered the harbour.
He felt calm, among friends on his last evening in town.
